lines.text: In the first month of the second year, the Israelites observed the Passover at twilight on the fourteenth day in the Wilderness of Sinai.
Some men unclean due to a dead body came before Moses and Aaron and asked why they should be excluded.
Moses told the men to wait, and the LORD said those unclean or away on a journey may still observe the Passover.
Those people were to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the third month, eating the lamb with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
A clean man not traveling who skipped the Passover was to be cut off, and a Moabite living among them followed the same statute.
